title: Guided filing journey — ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
Once signed in — the app redirects any signed-out visitor to a login page first — you land on a dark single-page app. The top bar reads "ANDS Studio" with the tagline "file a drug like a story", plus links "My dossiers" and "Portfolio". The hero headline says "File a drug with Health Canada, like telling a story." and the intro ends "No regulatory background needed." You click "Start my submission →"; beneath it a footnote says "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically".

The screen splits into three panels. A left rail titled "Your filing journey" lists eleven steps: "Get oriented", "Set up your company", "Get your product's file number", "Start a submission", "Add your documents", "Check your submission", "Pay the fees", "Get it approved", "Sign", "Submit to Health Canada", "Track & respond". Done steps show a checkmark and "Done"; the current one says "You're here"; later steps show a padlock and a reason such as needing to complete the prior step first.

The center card shows numbering like "Step 1 of 10" (the count is zero-based, so the opening step reads "Step 0 of 10"), a plain-language teaching paragraph with defined terms, and one primary button plus a "Next:" hint. The opening "Get oriented" step presents a form headed "Tell me about your drug": fields "What's your drug?", "What are you filing?" (options include "Generic of an approved brand (ANDS)" and "A brand-new drug (NDS)"), "Dosage form", and a checkbox "It's for a new use the brand isn't approved for". Clicking "Check my pathway" returns a verdict notice and any warnings.

The company step asks for "Your Health Canada Company ID" (placeholder "e.g. 12345") — a 5-digit ID you must already hold or request by email from Health Canada; a secondary link offers "I've requested it — continue while it's pending →". The dossier step requires a "Dossier ID" in a specific format (one letter plus 6–7 digits, placeholder "e123456"); on leaving the field you see "✓ Valid Dossier ID format." or an error. The submission step asks for "Applicant (your company name)" and "Drug product".

The right panel shows a 3D "Submission tower" that fills as modules complete, above a "Readiness" card reading "● READY TO FILE" or "● BLOCKED", a progress bar, per-step tiles, and — when blocked — "The single thing standing between you and ready:" with a resume button.

The documents step links out: "Open the Module builder →"; its Continue button stays disabled with the hint "Place the required documents to continue" until required documents are placed. Validation shows results like "✓ Validation passed" or an error count. The transmit step warns "You get three receipts, in order — don't stop at the FDA ACK:" with tiles "FDA MDN", "FDA ACK", and "HC ACK (Core ID)". The final step explains tracking timelines and decisions.
